section1.title: Information We Collect
section1.content: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you fill out our contact form. This may include your name, email address, phone number, and project details.

section2.title: How We Use Your Information
section2.content: We use the information we collect to respond to your inquiries, provide you with requested services, and improve our website and offerings.

section3.title: Information Sharing
section3.content: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to outside parties. This does not include trusted third parties who assist us in operating our website and servicing you.

section4.title: Data Security
section4.content: We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

section5.title: Cookies
section5.content: Our website may use cookies to enhance your experience. You can choose to have your computer warn you each time a cookie is being sent, or you can choose to turn off all cookies.

section6.title: Third-Party Links
section6.content: Occasionally, at our discretion, we may include or offer third-party products or services on our website. These third-party sites have separate and independent privacy policies.

section2.title: Services
section2.content: IMP Labs provides design, film production, and website development services. We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any part of our services at any time.

section3.title: Project Agreements
section3.content: All projects will be governed by a separate agreement that outlines the scope, timeline, deliverables, and pricing. These terms apply to your use of our website and initial communications.

section4.title: Intellectual Property
section4.content: Upon full payment, the client owns all rights to the deliverables created specifically for their project. IMP Labs retains the right to display the work in our portfolio unless otherwise agreed.

section5.title: Payment Terms
section5.content: Payment terms will be outlined in individual project agreements. Generally, we require a deposit before work begins and remaining payments upon milestone completion.
